verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe ANN search over vector fields, including multi-vector ANN, ANN with metadata pre-filtering, and a `client.search` example over query vectors. Community posts corroborate the index variants (IVF/FAISS-based, IVF_SQ8H) and report hands-on use that 'worked exactly as intended.' Missing for 10: no evidence of configurable distance metrics (e.g., L2/IP/cosine selection), and no detailed docs on index or metric parameters.
